messages:
ana: quick sync 1: proposing to UNPIN runtime 2.18 (restore to 2.17) for model_group=conversational-small. post-hotfix telemetry looks good but want a short guarded rollback window.

deploy-bot: proposed action: unpin runtime=2.17 scope=hosted,dedicated duration=45m requestor=ana reason='post-hotfix validation for conv-small; revert temporary 2.18 pin'

ops: ops needs rollback criteria + auto-rollforward plan. can't approve blind.

qa_lead: ran regression harness against 1200 prompts on 2.17 vs 2.18 patched. behavioral diffs are within noise (median perplexity delta 0.01). suggest canary at 10% for 20m then expand.

runtime_eng: runtime binary confirmed: revert path available, no model-binding changes. note: we must disable kernel-optim X in the revert path to avoid a regression seen last week.

sre_oncall: i'll add alerts: `increase(errors[5m]) > 0.75%` and `p99_token_latency > baseline * 1.20`. will post dashboard link.

ana: (typo) sorry, ana editing: plan: start 10% in us-east-staging for 20m, if green expand to 40% and monitor 30m, then lift globally during maintenance window.

deploy-bot: pending approvals: runtime,ops. to approve: `/deploybot approve-unpin 3401239999 --approvers="runtime,ops"`

runtime_eng: approved. revert path checked.

ops: approved for us-east-staging only. global wait until staging pass.

ana: kicking off canary at 3401240005 (10% in us-east-staging).

deploy-bot: action: unpinned runtime -> 2.17 for model_group=conversational-small in us-east-staging at 3401240005, canary_traffic=10%

qa_lead: 10m snapshot: error rate unchanged, p99 latency +4% (within threshold). running extended prompt battery now.

sre_oncall: dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/conv-small-unpin - alert rules attached.

runtime_eng: spotted one host using kernel-optim X unexpectedly; ops will cordon.

ops: cordoned affected host. no customer impact seen.

ana: 20m check: metrics stable. expanding to 40% across us-east + eu-west staging.

deploy-bot: action: expand canary at 3401240060 -> us-east=40%, eu-west=40%

qa_lead: 40m snapshot: recall test pass, latency nominal, no downstream ranking regressions.

ops: two transient OOM logs earlier but autoscale handled them; keeping watch.

ana: canary passed. scheduling global lift tomorrow in change window 04:00-05:00 UTC. will add runbook and auto-unpin on breach.

sre_oncall: auto-unpin configured: `/deploybot set-auto-unpin --thread=3401239999 --on-failure=true --targets=global` with rollback to runtime=2.18 if thresholds breached.

runtime_eng: opening hotfix-branch for immediate kernel toggle in case customers hit edgecases. PR: https://git.internal/r/conv-hotfix/pull/42

ops: runbook link: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/conv-small-unpin. pager on standby.

ana: thanks team. docs will post short changelog note after global completes. tagging @qa_lead for post-roll verification. :white_check_mark:
